about: Material 3 component tokens (md.comp.*) per platform. Generated; do not edit.
provenance: Each platform cell is [value, provenance]. own: the platform's own library; cross-source:<repo>: a concrete value of the same token from another official repository; derived:<token>: no repository gives a concrete value, one maps the token by reference to this token (use the platform's own value of it); library-default: no value (Flutter/Compose keep the library default, web omits the property). Keys with @<mode> are one context of a multi-context token (color scheme or motion scheme).
